messages.subject: Bangkok Airways | Sustainable aviation, stakeholder strategy and regional growth
messages.body:
Dear Bangkok Airways Leadership Team,

Bangkok Airways' sustainability agenda and regional aviation footprint align with an area of my experience that is often overlooked in a mining profile: aviation coordination and government-facing operating continuity.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy. My institutional interfaces include civil aviation authorities alongside mining, environmental, energy, labour and security agencies.

I bring experience coordinating official approvals, operating requirements, remote-site logistics and stakeholder commitments in a complex environment. I also support energy-transition and carbon-governance work, giving me a strong basis for sustainability and institutional strategy in aviation.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or country-facing leadership. I have attached a Bangkok Airways-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
